title: Unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce Zero-Day Exploited to Backdoor Online Stores
summary: Attackers are exploiting a new unpatched vulnerability in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce that lets them run malicious code on an online store's server without logging in, Dutch e-commerce security company Sansec said in an advisory published on September 5.
